title: AI Chiefs Call for Slower Model Development (Correct)
description:
"Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

Correct: video has been edited to fix the spelling of Bangkok in a segment.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Bloomberg: The Asia Trade begins
00:04:06 - Amodei, Altman and Musk back slower AI development
00:06:26 - Traders brace for Fed, BOJ decisions this week
00:08:26 - Saudi East-West pipeline shut down after attack
00:13:11 - Westpac's Sian Fenner on Asia's economic outlook
00:27:25 - Modi forges BRICS consensus amid Iran war
00:32:04 - IEA warns of further oil slump in coming months
00:37:21 - JAPAN AHEAD: DBS' Tieying Ma on BOJ, economic outlook
00:44:06 - Korea to debut after-hours trading today
00:47:35 - Markets open in Japan, South Korea and Australia
00:51:41 - OCBC's Vasu Menon on markets strategy
01:03:37 - Asia tech stocks fall on AI warnings
01:09:38 - Iran, US trade tanker attacks
01:13:13 - EXCLUSIVE: Chevron Australia President Balaji Krishnamurthy on Asia's energy outlook
01:23:46 - EXCLUSIVE: South Korean parliament member Cha Jiho on global AI hub
